description: Override geolocation (latitude/longitude, permission granted), timezone (IANA, e.g. America/Sao_Paulo) and/or locale (e.g. pt-BR) for every tab of this session, or reset them. Keep them consistent with the proxy/--geo country: a timezone that contradicts the IP is a bot signal.
